scope: Source-derived bit-packing and phase-contract replay; no browser/GPU pixels and no production implementation.

checks.name: two status bits are saturated by four operational states
legacy words leave bits 21..31 clear at the frozen budget
naively adding a high-bit reason corrupts the current visited decode
masking visited restores the exact node count
candidate reason round-trips through the existing 32-bit word
legacy words decode unchanged under the candidate decoder
invalid gradient is rejectable before writing HIT
a fully valid sample remains eligible for HIT
budget exhaustion remains orthogonal to invalid reason

candidate.mandatoryPhaseChange: validate gradient before committing HIT, or add a separate validity render/readback before visible tail submission

boundary.sourceConfirmed: The current 2-bit status cannot hold an invalid state. Spare high bits can hold an orthogonal reason only after visited masking.
boundary.phaseConfirmed: The current tail reads hitState textures and writes visible color after searchComplete; it has no state-output/readback path for INVALID_GRADIENT.
boundary.stillUnknown: Performance cost and real-device behavior of pre-hit gradient validation versus a separate validity pass.
